messages:
Harriet Cole: quick thread 1 - we keep losing track of postmortem action items. propose: a minimal, pasteable remediation block + automatic checkpoints + clear escalation. short takes?

Drew Park: yes. Make the block tiny so bots can parse. fields: remediation, owner, due, failure_mode, regression_check_url, checkpoints.

Samira Ali: also require a 'prevented_by' line and a simple 'verification' field (auto/manual). helps with dashboards.

Kenji Sato: IC rotation: 1-week shifts with a mandatory 1-hr shadow handoff on day 7. IC must pick comms cadence at declare: options quick/default/quiet. ops-bot pins the cadence.

Harriet Cole: example block (paste into PM/Jira comment):
```
remediation: short summary
owner: Name (team)
due: YYYY-MM-DD
failure_mode: [cache,auth,db]
prevented_by: brief guard
regression_check: https://smoke/run/123
verification: automated|manual
checkpoints: 36h:status,7d:status,30d:status
pm_link: https://pm/issue/123
```

Drew Park: governance: 36h missed -> owner ping; 7d missed -> escalate to tech lead and create follow-up card; 30d no regression -> create backlog bug and notify PM. ops-bot can automate.

Samira Ali: add a field 'recurrence: yes/no' and if yes require a long-term owner_tl. helps prioritize systemic work.

Kenji Sato: agree. also run a monthly tag-heatmap from failure_mode tags and post top-5 to #eng-leads. that'll drive platform investment instead of repeated hotfixes.

Harriet Cole: action items: Drew -> prototype parser + reminder jobs (due 10 days). Samira -> IC handoff one-pager + verification checklist (due 4 days). Kenji -> add heatmap job sketch and escalation flow (due 7 days). I'll add the block to current PM today.

Drew Park: confirmed, will start on parser.

Samira Ali: confirmed, drafting now.

Kenji Sato: confirmed.

ops-bot: Checkpoint scheduled: 36h reminder for REM-2024-321 (owner: Harriet Cole) will post to #eng-oncall at 3301237887.
